title: Single on purpose
caption: our sun has no partner star, and it still holds a whole solar system together

lines: Lots of stars come in pairs.
It holds eight planets in orbit
isn't a gap in your life.
My life is already a whole sky.

title: Romance yourself
caption: the planet of love carries a mirror. take the hint

lines: The planet of love carries a *mirror.*
Its symbol is said to be
It starts with how you look
I look at myself the way

title: Old light
cover: Some of your love is *old light*
caption: some of how you love is older than you. you still get to choose what shines next

lines: Some of the starlight you see tonight
left its star *before you were born.*
Some of how you love is old light too.
You can see where they came from
I am not *bound* to repeat it.
The love I give now is *mine.*

title: Ask for what you need
caption: the moon never pretends to be full. you don't have to either

lines: and it shows up as a sliver anyway.
so the right person knows how to *love* it.
I ask clearly, and I ask *kindly.*
The right person is *glad* I asked.

title: Read their light
caption: we know what stars are made of without touching one. people leave patterns in their love too

lines: We know what stars are made of
Every element leaves its own pattern
I tell you how *I* hear it.

title: A good apology
caption: even the flights to the moon drifted off course and made small corrections. say sorry like that

lines: Even the flights to the moon
A good apology works the same way.
I can be *wrong* and still be good.

title: Opposite, not enemies
caption: a full moon is the sun and moon on opposite sides. and it's the brightest night of the month

lines: The sun and moon have to sit
on either side of the earth.
And that's when the moon is *brightest.*
doesn't have to dim either of you.
I can disagree and still be *kind.*
even when we see it differently.

title: Long distance
caption: the moon moves every ocean on earth from almost four hundred thousand kilometres away

lines: That's how far the moon is,
The right pull reaches across it.
Miles don't *measure* how much I care.

title: Falling for potential
caption: the moon looks bigger on the horizon. it isn't. neither is who they might become

lines: The moon looks *huge* on the horizon.
Measure it, and it's no bigger
than when it's high above you.
I'm a partner, not a *rescue plan.*

title: The almost relationship
caption: the almost relationship wasn't a waste. it was a gravity assist

title: Near isn't available
caption: at new moon the moon is right there. its bright side is just turned away

lines: At new moon, the moon is right there,
I look for *open,* not just near.
I'm allowed to want the *whole* moon.
I show up lit, and I ask the same.

title: Shaped from the inside
caption: planets are round because their own gravity shapes them. you're allowed to be shaped by yours

lines: Planets are round for one reason.
You were big enough all along
to be shaped by your own *centre.*
I am shaped by what I *value.*

title: Don't settle
caption: city lights hide almost every star. settling does the same thing to what you want

lines: Far from any city, on a moonless night,
I remember what my sky *looks* like.
Enough is not the same as *right.*
I'm willing to wait for the *stars.*

title: Standards, not walls
caption: earth doesn't wall out the sun. it turns away what would hurt and lets the light in

lines: There's a wind blowing off the *sun.*
and over time it can strip
Its magnetic field turns the wind aside
A wall keeps out the *warmth* too.

title: Healing, slowly
caption: the moon drifts a little farther from us every year. too slow to feel. healing works like that

lines: You won't feel it day to day.
I'm healing, even when I can't *feel* it.
Every day puts a little more *space*

title: Blue sunsets
caption: from far away, mars looks red. stand on it at sunset and the sky turns blue

lines: But stand on it at sunset,
The right people stay for the sunset.

title: Room in the closeness
caption: when two galaxies merge, their stars almost never touch. that's what good closeness looks like

lines: Two lives pour into each other,
I can let someone all the way *in*

title: Steady light
caption: stars twinkle. planets mostly hold steady. that's the kind of love that feels safe

lines: They're close enough that their light
Not a spark you're always *guessing* at,
I don't have to *earn* my safety.
It's how I know love is *real.*

title: Soft love
caption: moonlight is just sunlight, softened enough to look at

lines: and reaches you hundreds of thousands
You can't look straight at the sun.
You can look at the moon for *hours.*

title: Loud love
caption: venus can get bright enough to cast a shadow. some love is meant to be seen

lines: On a dark night, far from city lights,
you can see your own shadow by it.
Some love is meant to be *seen.*
It posts you. It introduces you.
I don't have to be a *secret.*

title: Friends first
caption: most stars aren't born alone. they start out side by side, in the same cloud

lines: from the same cloud of gas,
Some of the best love starts there,

title: Flirt a little
caption: every august the earth runs through old comet dust and the sky flirts back

lines: Once a year, the earth flies
through the dust of an old comet.
Each grain burns up as a *shooting star.*
Your fifth house is romance and *play.*
It doesn't have to mean forever.
It just has to feel like *fun.*
I let myself enjoy the spark

title: Made of stars
caption: the iron in your blood was made inside a star. you don't have to borrow your shine

lines: So was the calcium in your *bones.*
You don't have to *borrow* a shine.
I don't shrink to make room.

title: After the crater
caption: the moon keeps every crater. the earth has weather. you're more earth than moon

lines: With no air and no rain,
Rain and time soften its craters
It left a mark, not a *verdict.*
I heal, and I can *trust* again.

title: Always falling, never gone
caption: the moon is always falling toward us and always missing. that's all an orbit is

lines: Right now, the moon is *falling* toward us.
It just moves sideways fast enough
If they love you, they're choosing
to come back around, again and again.
I don't have to hold on *tighter.*

title: The sun doesn't leave
caption: the sun doesn't set. the earth turns away from it. notice when you're the one turning

lines: It stays exactly where it is.
Night isn't the sun leaving you.
it can feel like it's leaving.
I can say I need space

title: Closest to the sun
caption: in early january the earth is the closest it gets to the sun all year. even when it's freezing out

lines: The earth is the closest it gets
even when it's *freezing* where you are.
Cold doesn't mean far from the *light.*
It's just a different kind of season.
I am closer to love than it *feels.*

title: Sunday, still moving
caption: sunday is named after the sun, and even on the slowest one you're flying around it

lines: And even on the slowest one,
Like everyone's paired off but you.
A quiet day is not a *lonely* life.

title: It was a shooting star
caption: most shooting stars are smaller than a grain of sand. they burn that bright because they fall so fast

lines: A crush can be like that.
mostly made of how fast you *fell.*
It's okay to let it burn out.
I fall for the ones who *catch* me.

title: Every pull is returned
caption: in physics, every pull gets pulled back. if yours never was, it wasn't an orbit

lines: The earth pulls on the moon,
and the moon pulls the earth *back,*

scenes.header: WHEN THEY DON'T LOVE YOU BACK

lines: I save my pull for someone

title: Earthshine
caption: on a crescent moon the dark part glows. that's light bounced off earth. you deserve some back

lines: Next crescent moon, look at the *dark* part.
You light up their dark parts
I'm allowed to *need* a listener too.
I let the people I hold, hold *me.*

title: Saying it first
caption: light can take tens of thousands of years to leave the sun's core, then eight minutes to reach you

lines: can take tens of thousands of years
to fight its way to the surface.
Saying I love you first is like that.
My love is *brave* enough to go first.

title: A shared centre
caption: binary stars don't circle each other. they both circle a point between them

lines: They both orbit a point *between* them,
Choose one who feels like a *best friend.*

title: Changing each other
caption: the earth and moon have been shaping each other for billions of years

lines: The moon is making your days *longer.*
Its pull slows the earth's spin,
And the earth turned the moon
Growing together isn't staying the same.
We don't have to stay who we were.

title: The quiet kind
caption: the sun's corona is there every day. you only see it when the loud part is covered

lines: You've probably never seen the sun's *corona.*
It's a soft glow around the sun,
You only see it in an *eclipse,*
when the bright part is covered.
I don't need *noise* to feel loved.

title: Your north star
caption: the north star isn't the brightest star in the sky. it's just the one that doesn't move

lines: It's just the one that doesn't *move.*
The whole sky turns around it.
Not the *loudest* person in the room.
I want love I can *navigate* by.
I choose the person who feels like *home,*
not the one who feels like a *storm.*

title: Closer to the warmth
caption: the closer a comet gets to the sun, the brighter it shines. even though it's changing

lines: A comet is mostly *ice* and dust.
As it gets closer to the sun,
The closer you get to warmth,
I can be scared and still stay *open.*

title: Right person, wrong time
caption: the moon passes the sun every month. it only lines up for an eclipse a few times a year

lines: Every month, the moon passes the sun.
But its path is tilted, just slightly,
a little high or a little *low.*
The right person at the wrong time
The sky lines up when it lines up.
I don't have to *force* the timing.

title: Still lit
caption: in a lunar eclipse the moon doesn't go dark. it glows red with every sunrise and sunset on earth

lines: The moon doesn't go dark in an *eclipse.*
When it slips into the earth's shadow,
lit by every sunrise and sunset on earth
Grief can feel like that shadow.
And still, light finds its way to you.
Loving again doesn't *erase* what you had.
I carry what I lost with *love.*

title: The far side
caption: the far side of the moon isn't dark. it gets just as much sun. we just never saw it

scenes.header: THE FAR SIDE OF THE MOON
lines: Nobody saw the far side of the moon
The parts of you nobody's seen
come around to the other side.
I let the right people *see* me.
All of me is *worth* the light.

title: Worth the wait
caption: venus spins so slowly one turn takes longer than its year. it's still the brightest planet up there

lines: and so is the love I'm waiting for.
